messages:
marta: Heads-up — staging AWQ roll with group_size=64 + act-quant ON produced a regression on the longform eval suite. Quick numbers: pass_rate went from 94.2% -> 88.1%, token-level KL up ~0.18, and we see ~2% traces with token-repeat / loopiness on steps >1500.
ajay: Oof. Did the canary run hit the new runtime revision or just the config change?
marta: Config-only change on the same runtime binary. Canary had ~5k requests over 6h.
devon: Can you paste the exact AWQ config you pushed?
marta: Sure — used the same cluster as previous canary. Config snippet:
```json
{"awq": {"group_size": 64, "act_quant": true, "block_size": 128, "quant_scheme": "symmetric", "fallback": "fp16"}}
```
marta: Sample tail of a failing trace:
```
[INFER] seq=2048 idx=1578 token=\"the\" repeat_count=24 kv_cache_miss=true softmax_temp=1.0
...generation stalls, repeats 'the' 20+ times...
```
kai: Interesting — repetition at long ctx could be KV-cache aliasing or quantization-induced scale mismatch for high-activation buckets. Any change in activation histograms vs previous canary?
marta: Yes — we logged per-layer activation std dev distribution. Layer 10/11 have a slight left shift; mean magnitude down ~6% for a subset of seeds.
ajay: Activation shift + act-quant sounds suspicious. Act quant expects some calibration; did we rerun calibration with the new group size? Or reused the previous scale tables?
marta: We reused the existing calibration artifacts (we didn't re-calibrate for group=64), assuming group sizing only affects packing. That may be the clue.
kai: That could explain it. AWQ group_size changes the per-group activation statistics used for act quantization. If we don't recompute scale factors, quantization bins misalign.
sylvia: We started a canary rollback, pausing the rollout. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by sylvia at 2026-03-20T12:11:04Z
devon: Proposed quick bisect matrix:
- baseline: group=16, act_quant=true (previous good)
- try A: group=32, act_quant=true + recalibrate
- try B: group=64, act_quant=true + recalibrate
- try C: group=64, act_quant=false (to isolate act-quant)
- try D: group=128, act_quant=true + recalibrate (stress test)
marta: I can run A/B/C on a small 1k eval sample (longform shards) tonight. Will log activation histograms + KL diffs.
kai: Add a tiny synthetic prompt that stresses low-prob tail (repeat-prone) so we can reproduce locally. Also capture per-token logprobs.
ajay: Infra note — when running recalib, make sure to pin the RNG seed and dump per-group scale files to s3:/redwood/awq-calibs/3632109876/
marta: Will do. Hypothesis: reuse-of-calib + larger group-size => coarser quant bins => occasional saturations on large negative/positive activations causing softmax sharpness changes -> repetition.
sylvia: Assigning: marta -> run A/B/C evals and upload artifacts. kai -> local repro + synthetic stress prompt. devon -> ensure canary rollback complete and help with rerun infra. ajay -> permission for s3 write for marta.
marta: I'll post a short results table when done. If recalib fixes it on group=64, we can re-run a Canary with recalib and keep the rollout paused till verified. If not, we'll fallback to group=32 or disable act-quant for longctx tiers.
ajay: Thanks team. Keep notes in the bakeoff doc (link: https://redwood.internal/bakeoffs/awq-coldstart-drift) — add raw artifacts under the timestamped folder.
kai: One more thing — collect per-bucket saturation counts (values clipped to quant range). That'll tell us if bins are hitting extremes.
marta: Yep — logs will include "saturation_count" per layer/group.
sylvia: Ping me when results are uploaded. I'll coordinate canary re-open or rollback to baseline.
marta: Uploading initial A run now (small eval). ETA ~40m. Will follow up with condensed numbers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ajay: Appreciate it.
